subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a core config surface now, and should the default/no-override path preserve current `bootstrap-extra-files` inclusion for subagent and cron sessions?
rationale: The source gap is real, but choosing a new config/default surface and changing hook-extra semantics affects existing session context and upgrade behavior, which automation should not settle without maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair and sponsor this PR
options.body: Preserve current no-override hook-extra behavior, add public docs, then continue maintainer review of this focused tier API.

options.title: Fold into broader bootstrap selection
options.body: Pause this PR and design one broader selector contract for tiering, per-session filtering, hook extras, and prompt-pressure work.

options.title: Decline the new knob
options.body: Keep fixed session filters and route users to existing bootstrap budgets, lightweight context, and hook configuration instead.

recommendation.title: Repair and sponsor this PR
recommendation.body: Preserve current no-override hook-extra behavior, add public docs, then continue maintainer review of this focused tier API.
